label: Salida_Producción
code_lines: SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T4.N_SCN AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,
T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1 AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1 AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN,
WHERE 	T1.AÑO>=&ANIO AND T1.C_CUENTA='Producción' and t1.Fuente='CI' and T2.C_SI_SCN in ('S.122','S.124') and t1.sector in (321,322,361,362)

GROUP BY  T1.AÑO, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN,T4.N_SCN,T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN,
